name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd

business.about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is a leading end-to-end and IoT solutions-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company. The company provides conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support for major players in the automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, outer-space, nuclear, medical, railways, Internet of Things ("IoT"), Information Technology ("IT") and other segments. [1]

calls: Growth is decelerating: revenue CAGR 47.7% over 3y vs 53.9% over 5y
Margins expanding: 16% latest vs 13% average of prior years
Operating leverage: PAT compounding faster (56.5%) than revenue (47.7%)
Working capital stretching: cash-conversion cycle 162 → 193 days in 3 years
Heavy capex under way: CWIP is 34% of fixed assets
Weak cash conversion: 5-yr operating cash flow is -0.63× reported profit
Free cash flow negative in 5 of the last 5 years

promise_verdict.verdict: Kaynes has a pattern of guiding high and resetting: FY26 went ₹4,500 cr → ₹4,000 cr → ₹3,626 cr delivered, and late-2025's '~50%' growth framing has become +20% in H1 FY27 and +4.5% in Q2. The bigger gap is cash — FY26 operating cash flow of −₹600 cr against ₹364 cr profit — so the Q3 FY27 receivables promise is the test that matters.

promise_verdict_by: claude-opus-5-5 (reasoning tier) — generated in the build session from the same extracted inputs; no API key in the prototype

bull: Revenue compounded ~54% a year over five years (₹420 cr FY21 → ₹3,626 cr FY26).
OSAT and PCB add a second engine: management has committed ₹500 cr of combined revenue from H2 FY27.
Board approved a TFT display-module JV with Toyokawa Techno (14 Nov 2026), widening the product stack.
bear: FY26 operating cash flow −₹600 cr vs ₹364 cr profit; free cash flow negative five years running.
Guidance credibility: FY26 target cut from ₹4,500 cr to ₹4,000 cr, then ₹3,626 cr delivered.
Q2 FY27 revenue +4.5% YoY, EBITDA margin 13% (9-quarter low), PAT −66%; debtor days doubled to 154.
